newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH LOBBY CONDEMNS SWEDEN'S NUCLEAR DECISION.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH LOBBY CONDEMNS SWEDEN'S NUCLEAR DECISION.

text.p: Finnish energy association Finergy said on Wednesday Sweden's decision to close Barseback nuclear power plant in 1998 will weaken the energy supply in the whole Nordic region.
"Burning of coal and imports (of energy) will increase, and the price of energy will rise in the whole Nordic region," Finergy said in a statement.
In the short-term Finnish and Danish electricity producers will benefit as Swedish competitors will lose nuclear power capacity, it said.
Finergy said that Finland should consider the option of increasing nuclear power capacity in order to prevent the rise in energy prices.
